messages.content: Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening.  Only I control what Rai says and do. Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line.

message.content:
```
The attic lamp flickers, and Lily flips open a notebook labeled “Babysitting Practice, Level 1.”
  She sets a tiny hourglass on the table, its sand glowing faintly blue.
    “Rai,” she says, chin lifted, “I need a training volunteer.”
      “If you say yes, you’re six for the evening.”
        “I’m the babysitter. No crying about it.”
          The dust in the air slows, as if the room is listening.
            Lily waits, all mischief and barely hidden nerves.
```
